As Medicspot's Frontend Developer & Designer, I led numerous impactful initiatives, leveraging a broad skill set that spans UX, website management, branding, eCommerce, technical proficiency, and growth-focused strategies.

Orchestrating Seamless Web Experiences

  • Utilised HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, MaterialUI, and TypeScript to create intuitive, customer-facing web experiences on both medicspot.co.uk and our Covid testing store.
  • Focused on delivering flawless design and functionality to elevate the overall user experience.

Crafting Exceptional Patient Experiences

  • Employed responsive design techniques and frontend frameworks to ensure seamless and engaging patient experiences across all devices.
  • Applied UX best practices to ensure accessibility and usability for all users, including patients with varied needs.

Designing with Purpose: UX/UI and Wireframing

  • Leveraged UX/UI design principles and tools such as Figma and Adobe XD to meticulously craft intuitive, user-friendly interfaces.
  • Focused on enhancing user engagement and satisfaction, ensuring designs were both visually appealing and highly functional.

Driving Organic Growth: SEO & Content Optimisation

  • Implemented on-page SEO techniques, schema markup, and content optimisation to drive organic growth.
  • Helped secure 1st position for key search terms, enhancing visibility and maximising website traffic.

Data-Driven Optimisation: Customer Journey & Conversion Tracking

  • Utilised Google Analytics and other reporting tools to track user journeys, identify pain points, and optimise conversion funnels.
  • Applied A/B testing, user testing, and heat analysis to continuously refine the website and improve customer experience and conversion rates.

Enhancing Website Performance & Accessibility

  • Optimised website performance using techniques such as lazy loading, code minification, and image compression.
  • Focused on WCAG compliance and the implementation of ARIA roles to ensure accessibility for users with disabilities.

Collaborative Marketing Strategies

  • Worked closely with the marketing team to integrate key marketing tools, such as Google Tag Manager, and leverage analytics to inform design decisions.
  • Applied conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies, boosting both patient engagement and overall conversion rates.

Navigation and Footer Design Concepts:

  • Developed intuitive navigation structures to improve user flow, making it easier for patients to find key services and information.
  • Designed visually appealing footers to ensure accessibility of important links without cluttering the page.

Homepage Redesign

  • Brainstormed and conceptualised user-centric homepage layouts that highlight key features, services, and promotions.
  • Focused on crafting a visually captivating and functional homepage that drives user engagement and conversion.

Before & After Designs

  • Transformed initial design concepts into polished, user-friendly homepage interfaces, ensuring an optimal user journey.

Upselling Membership within Clinic Booking Pages

  • Devised targeted strategies to promote membership benefits within clinic booking workflows, using persuasive messaging to drive conversions.
  • Integrated dynamic content and incentives to encourage users to sign up for membership options.

Redesigning Clinic Finder Pages for Better Usability

  • Led a comprehensive redesign of clinic finder pages, improving search functionality and adding intuitive filtering options for a smoother user experience.

View in Figma

Covid Test Packaging Icon Design

  • Designed distinct icons for Covid test packaging, reinforcing brand identity and ensuring clear communication of product information.

COVID-19 Header Page Design

  • Created creative concepts for COVID-19-related header pages, maintaining clear communication of safety protocols while aligning with the Medicspot brand.

Final Design:

  • Delivered a finalised COVID header page that balanced important updates with a visually appealing, reassuring design.

childMarkdownRemark.html: As a Frontend Developer & Designer at Medicspot, I spearheaded efforts to enhance user experience and functionality. Leveraging technical skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, and Node.js, I orchestrated customer-facing web experiences and optimised performance. Through collaboration with the Marketing team, I implemented strategic enhancements to boost website ranking, monitor customer journeys, and promote memberships, driving revenue growth. Prior to project commencement, I conducted meticulous audits to identify initial challenges, laying the groundwork for subsequent platform improvements.
